notes: An electric store cart: a 12 V 35 Ah AGM battery, a 12 V 7 A charger, a geared hub motor and a PWM controller. The parts list prints 280-1797 for both the charger cord and the PVC-free seat, so check which one a cart has before ordering; the manual is undated.

gaps: The manual says the hub motor is a 'direct current, brushed disc, 12 (or 24) volt brake, geared motor'; the wording leaves open whether 12 (or 24) V is the motor's or the brake's rating.

Part 280-1797 is printed for both the 6 ft coiled charger cord (item 7; page 5 also gives it as the cord) and the PVC-free seat with seat switch (item 17); the manual does not say if either is a typo.

Page 15 is flattened text with the part numbers in a separate block from the descriptions, so they were paired by order; 280-1187 (potentiometer) and 280-1405 (rocker switch) were matched against Parts Town's Mart Cart listings, which name the same parts.
Page 5 prints 280-1749 beside the charger drawing without a label; it is not used. The parts list gives the charger as 280-1743.
Part numbers 280-1214, 260-1228, 280-1569 and 280-1600 appear unlabeled on pages 4, 7 and 9; they are matched to parts by the parts list on page 14.
Wattage, gear ratio, controller ratings, battery group size, frame material and the year are not given, so none are claimed.
The manual names no publisher; its contact is a Service Department (800-548-3373, techservice@assembledproducts.com), and Assembled Products Corporation is the Mart Cart maker.
Rear wheel count is left out: the list only says one bushing, grommet and ring on each wheel, and a separate tire is listed for the hub motor.
method: ManualsLib preview of the Mart Cart 3563 Technical Overview (21 pages, https://www.manualslib.com/manual/836910/Mart-Cart-3563.html): viewer pages 4, 5, 7, 9, 14 and 15 opened and read.
Page 14 reads as a table; the key rows were read twice with the same part numbers.

Parts Town listings for Mart Cart 280-1187 (potentiometer) and 280-1405 (rocker switch), https://www.partstown.com/mart-cart/mct280-1187 and https://www.partstown.com/mart-cart/mct280-1405, were opened only to check the page 15 pairings.
Page 18 (safety check) was opened and states no ratings, so it is not used.

comps.spec: Sealed AGM lead-acid battery, 12 V 35 Ah. Parts list item 6, part 280-1214 (listed as 'Battery - 35AH').

12 V 7 A charger with Intelli-Charge: it stops charging when the battery is full and can stay plugged into a wall socket. Parts list item 9, part 280-1743 (7 A, 3-prong pigtail). Power cord 280-1797 (6 ft coiled).
Hub motor described as direct current, brushed and geared, with a brake powered by two black leads; the description gives 12 (or 24) V. Parts list item 30, part 280-1600.

PWM (pulse width modulator) controller, parts list item 25, part 280-1569. Page 7 calls it the central processor for the cart's electronics; with the potentiometer it controls the hub motor's speed and direction. It has a 10-pin terminal.
Potentiometer assembly, part 280-1187, in the steering column and control box parts list (item 4). It works with the PWM controller to set the hub motor's speed and direction.
Horn, on pin 8 (violet wire) of the PWM controller's 10-pin terminal.
15 A circuit breaker, part 260-1228 (parts list item 8), in the battery cover assembly 280-1712. Parts list note: use 280-1610 instead if the cart has no battery cover 280-1712.
Mini fuse, 5 A, part 280-1799 (parts list item 10). Parts list note: use fuse 280-1627 if the cart has no battery cover 280-1712.
Seat switch, part 280-1553, for the PVC-free seat (item 18). The padded seat (200-1558) takes seat switch 280-1484.
Rocker switch, part 280-1405, in the steering column and control box parts list (item 6).

Main frame 280-1818 (listed as containing the bumper and hardware), seat mount tubes 280-1262 (LH) and 280-1261 (RH), basket tubes 280-1264 (2 each), fork assembly 280-1273. 'Lil Max' basket 200-1802.
Casters, 2 in, part 200-1052 (parts list item 31), listed as 2 each.

Rear wheels, 8 in, part 280-1268 (listed as Poly-U), with 5/8 in bushing 000-1224, 5/8 in grommet 280-1335 and E-type retaining ring 000-1075, each listed as 1 on each wheel. A separate tire for the hub motor is part 280-1346.
